## Origins and references

Italian brainrot is a series of internet memes that emerged in early 2025, mostly featuring AI-generated animal and object hybrids with Italian-style names. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=A17-0001 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2025 | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/italian-brainrot-ai-italian-animals | checked=2026-11-06]
Tralalero Tralala is widely considered the first example of the Italian brainrot trend, although the trend's exact origin is unclear. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=A17-0002 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | event=2025-01 | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/italian-brainrot-ai-italian-animals | checked=2026-11-06]
Internet users made memes of actor Dwayne Johnson rhyming about absurd topics in October 2023, and the nonsense phrase Tralalero tralala from one was later used as the basis for Italian brainrot. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=A17-0003 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2023-10 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Only Wikipedia states this origin link in the pages read, and the Dwayne Johnson memes are not separately sourced there.]
The creation of Tralalero Tralala is often attributed to the TikTok user @eZburger401, who posted the character's audio in January 2025. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=A17-0004 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | event=2025-01 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Wikipedia says the creation is often attributed to this account, which is an attribution rather than a settled fact. Know Your Meme says the account was banned from TikTok in early 2025.] [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tralalero-tralala | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Tralalero_Tralala | checked=2026-11-06]
Tung Tung Tung Sahur was created in 2025 using DALL-E by the Indonesian TikTok user known online as Noxa. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=A17-0006 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2025 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Wikipedia gives the creator's full name; this line uses only the online name. The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists the creator handle as @noxaasht.] [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tung-tung-tung-sahur | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | checked=2026-11-06]
The earliest known Tung Tung Tung Sahur image was posted by the TikTok account @noxaasht on February 28, 2025. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tung-tung-tung-sahur | id=A17-0007 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2025-02-28 | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | checked=2026-11-06]
The name Tung Tung Tung Sahur comes from an Indonesian saying that alerts Muslims that it is time for sahur, the meal eaten before dawn during Ramadan. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tung-tung-tung-sahur | id=A17-0008 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Know Your Meme also says the phrase was used online as early as 2013.] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | checked=2026-11-06]
Tung Tung Tung Sahur is based on the kentongan, a traditional Indonesian drum. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tung-tung-tung-sahur | id=A17-0009 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | checked=2026-11-06]
The name Bombardiro Crocodilo is commonly misspelled as Bombardino Crocodilo or Bombardilo Crocodilo. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=A17-0011 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
In Italian brainrot, Bombardiro Crocodilo is the brother of Bombombini Gusini, a goose with fighter jet wings. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=A17-0012 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The Steal a Brainrot wiki describes Bombombini Gusini's wings differently. See the conflict record for this character.]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists @aironicfun and @ncracfbcr4x as the creators of Ballerina Cappuccina. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Ballerina_Cappuccina | id=A17-0014 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Community wiki infobox only. The wiki does not give a source for this creator entry.]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists @alexey_pigeon as the creator of Chimpanzini Bananini. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Chimpanzini_Bananini | id=A17-0015 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Community wiki infobox only. The same handle is listed as creator of many other brainrots on the wiki.]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists @mrbrainrot420 as the creator of Trippi Troppi. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Trippi_Troppi | id=A17-0016 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Community wiki infobox only.]
The original Trippi Troppi is a fish-bear, and the cat-shrimp version is the more popular and iconic one, according to the Steal a Brainrot wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Trippi_Troppi | id=A17-0017 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | checked=2026-11-06]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists ofuscabreno as the creator of Brr Brr Patapim. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Brr_Brr_Patapim | id=A17-0018 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Community wiki infobox only.]
Boneca Ambalabu is one of the Indonesian spin-offs of the Italian brainrot trend, alongside Tung Tung Tung Sahur and Hotspot Bro. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/italian-brainrot-ai-italian-animals | id=A17-0019 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Single source. The Steal a Brainrot wiki gives its creator as @ofuscabreno, which was not checked further.] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Boneca_Ambalabu | checked=2026-11-06]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists mzic2403 as the creator of Strawberry Elephant. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Strawberry_Elephant | id=A17-0020 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Community wiki infobox only.]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki lists zhumaokele as the creator of Meowl. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Meowl | id=A17-0021 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Community wiki infobox only.]
John Pork is a viral internet meme character with a human body and the head of a pig. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Pork | id=A17-0022 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki says John Pork is a fictional character and not a real person. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Pork | id=A17-0023 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Nyan Cat is a YouTube video uploaded in April 2011 that became an internet meme. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyan_Cat | id=A17-0024 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2011-04 | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Gattatino_Nyanino | checked=2026-11-06]
The Nyan Cat GIF was posted on April 2, 2011 by Christopher Torres on his LOL-Comics website. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyan_Cat | id=A17-0025 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2011-04-02 | checked=2026-11-06]
The original Nyan Cat song, Nyanyanyanyanyanyanya!, was first uploaded to Niconico by the user daniwell on July 25, 2010. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyan_Cat | id=A17-0026 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2010-07-25 | checked=2026-11-06]
The 6-7 meme was further popularized in March 2025 by a boy who became known as the 67 Kid. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/6-7_(meme) | id=A17-0029 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2025-03 | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | checked=2026-11-06]
The 67 brainrot in Steal a Brainrot is based on the 67 meme, which features a blonde boy known as the 67 Kid shouting six-seven. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=A17-0030 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/6-7_(meme) | checked=2026-11-06]
Skibidi Toilet is an animated web series by Alexey Gerasimov that first aired on YouTube in February 2023. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skibidi_Toilet | id=A17-0032 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2023-02-07 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The February 7, 2023 start date is from the Wikipedia infobox.] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Skibidi_Toilet | checked=2026-11-06]
Skibidi Toilet is the first and only human-type Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot that originally comes from a meme. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Human-Based_Brainrots | id=A17-0033 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skibidi_Toilet | checked=2026-11-06]
Appelini in Steal a Brainrot is based on AI Fruits, a TikTok series about humanoid fruit. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Appelini | id=A17-0034 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Bananito in Steal a Brainrot was inspired by AI Fruits, a series on TikTok. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bananito | id=A17-0035 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Strawberrita in Steal a Brainrot was inspired by an AI-generated TikTok series called Fruit Love Island, also known as AI Fruits. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Strawberrita | id=A17-0036 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
The NPC version of Bambu Bambu Sahur on the Aura Farm Boat is inspired by the Indonesian Aura kid meme. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bambu_Bambu_Sahur | id=A17-0037 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Boatito Auratito in Steal a Brainrot is a reference to the Aura Farming Kid meme. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Boatito_Auratito | id=A17-0038 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Dul Dul Dul is an Indonesian brainrot based on the hairstyle gundul, which means bald. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Dul_Dul_Dul | id=A17-0039 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Horegini Boom in Steal a Brainrot is based on a culture in Indonesia called Sound Horeg. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Horegini_Boom | id=A17-0040 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
La Cucaracha in Steal a Brainrot is inspired by the Mexican song La Cucaracha. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/La_Cucaracha | id=A17-0041 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Mi Gatito in Steal a Brainrot is inspired by the song Ay Mi Gatito by Princesita Kelly. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mi_Gatito | id=A17-0042 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The same wiki page's infobox names Princesita Kelly as creator.]
Chicleteira Champeona in Steal a Brainrot has a red shirt and pants with the number 19 as a reference to the footballer Lamine Yamal. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Chicleteira_Champeona | id=A17-0043 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
The name of Capitano Americano in Steal a Brainrot is based on Captain America. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Capitano_Americano | id=A17-0044 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Chicken Zombie in Steal a Brainrot is a reference to Chicken Jockey from Minecraft. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Chicken_Zombie | id=A17-0045 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Clickerino Crabo was inspired by a deleted Roblox game called Crab Clicker. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Clickerino_Crabo | id=A17-0046 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]
Donkeyturbo Express in Steal a Brainrot is a reference to the Brainrot Express of the North Pole Event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Donkeyturbo_Express | id=A17-0047 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The page also says both are based on The Polar Express, a Christmas movie. The design of Elefanto Frigo in Steal a Brainrot is inspired by the riddle of how to put an elephant in a fridge. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Elefanto_Frigo | id=A17-0048 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]

Draculino in Steal a Brainrot is based on Dracula. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Draculino | id=A17-0051 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06]

## Collaborations and crossovers

The Bruno Mars concert in Steal a Brainrot was a one-day event on January 17, 2026, which Roblox promoted on X the day before. [source: https://www.dexerto.com/roblox/steal-a-brainrots-bruno-mars-concert-hits-12-7-million-concurrent-players-3305913/ | id=A18-0001 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | pub=2026-01-17 | event=2026-01-17 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Dexerto quotes Roblox's X post of January 16, 2026. Guinness World Records gives the same date.] [source: https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/commercial/2026/2/bruno-mars-hosts-largest-concert-in-a-videogame-during-steal-a-brainrot-on-roblox | checked=2026-11-06]
Guinness World Records lists the Steal a Brainrot Bruno Mars concert as the largest music concert in a videogame by a single artist. [source: https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/782027-largest-music-concert-in-a-videogame-by-a-single-artist | id=A18-0003 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-01-17 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Guinness lists the record under Steal a Brainrot, Roblox and Bruno Mars.] [source: https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/commercial/2026/2/bruno-mars-hosts-largest-concert-in-a-videogame-during-steal-a-brainrot-on-roblox | checked=2026-11-06]
Think Influence became the exclusive global agent for Steal a Brainrot in September 2025, to expand the game into consumer products, partnerships and media. [source: https://www.licenseglobal.com/video-games/think-influence-appointed-exclusive-global-agent-for-steal-a-brainrot- | id=A18-0005 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2025-09-18 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Think Influence is also named as a producing partner on the Steal a Brainrot movie.]
Fortnite's Steal the Brainrot Creative map is an officially licensed Steal a Brainrot experience, and it is not the Stealing Brainrots map that Spyder Games sued in 2025. Jandel, the creator of Grow a Garden, challenged Sammy to an Admin Abuse war on X in August 2025, offering to donate $5,000 to Team Water for every one million players Grow a Garden had more than Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://techwiser.com/grow-a-garden-steal-a-brainrot-admin-abuse-war/ | id=A18-0007 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-08-15 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The challenge was a post on X by Jandel. The war itself was held on August 23, 2025.]
Steakini Fattini is the first Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot based on a streamer, and it is largely based on YouTuber Steak's Roblox avatar. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Steakini_Fattini | id=A18-0008 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-05-30 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Fandom wiki only. The Steak Admin Abuse of May 30, 2026 was not found in press search.]
Caylusaurus is the second Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot based on a streamer, after Steakini Fattini, and it is based on YouTuber Caylus. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Caylusaurus | id=A18-0009 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-06-06 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Fandom wiki only. The songs played in the Steal a Brainrot Bruno Mars concert were I Just Might and Locked Out of Heaven. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bruno_Mars_Event | id=A18-0011 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-01-17 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Fandom wiki only. Brunito Marsito is the first official celebrity collaboration Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot. John Pork was added to Steal a Brainrot after the meme's creator gave permission for the character to be used in the game. ## Community and culture

Sammy (SpyderSammy) said in an X post that Sammy would match Jandel's wager and donate to Team Water no matter who won the Admin Abuse War. [source: https://beebom.com/poll-who-will-win-admin-abuse-war-grow-a-garden-vs-steal-a-brainrot/ | id=A06-0003 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2025-08-23 | event=2025-08 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Sammy's own post was not opened. Beebom quotes it.]
Steal a Brainrot won the Best Creative Direction award at the 2025 Roblox Innovation Awards, which were announced in September 2025. [source: https://www.pocketgamer.biz/roblox-reveals-2025-innovation-awards-winners | id=A06-0007 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | pub=2025-09-09 | event=2025-09 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Grow a Garden won the most awards that year.] [source: https://beebom.com/roblox-innovation-awards-2025-winners | checked=2026-11-06]
A TikTok clip of a player screaming after one of their Brainrots was stolen in Steal a Brainrot was posted on June 15, 2025, and gained over 800,000 views in nine days. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/subcultures/steal-a-brainrot | id=A06-0020 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | event=2025-06-15 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=View count as reported by Know Your Meme. Wikipedia reports that children crying over stolen Brainrots drew viral TikTok and YouTube videos.] [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steal_a_Brainrot | checked=2026-11-06]
The removal of Tung Tung Tung Sahur from Steal a Brainrot drew online backlash and memes in mid-September 2025, with some people blaming Sammy and others blaming Noxa and Mementum Lab. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/events/tung-tung-tung-sahur-removed-from-steal-a-brainrot | id=A06-0021 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | pub=2025-09-17 | event=2025-09 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Dataconomy also reports widespread backlash and misinformation circulating after the removal.] [source: https://dataconomy.com/2025/09/19/steal-a-brainrot-removes-tung-tung-tung-sahur-character-over-copyright | checked=2026-11-06]
A 2017 rumor said the John Doe Roblox account would hack players every March 18, and Steal a Brainrot's John Doe Hacking event ran on March 18, 2026. [source: https://techwiser.com/steal-a-brainrot-john-doe/ | id=A06-0025 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-18 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The rumor part is from TechWiser. The 2026 event date is from the wiki only. The wiki says the event was most likely staged, and no reputable press was found confirming a real intrusion.] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Doe_Hacking | checked=2026-11-06]
Steal a Brainrot's developer Sammy has many impersonators on YouTube, according to the community wiki, and Sammy's main personal channel is mostly used to talk to YouTubers in streams. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Socials | id=A06-0027 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Wiki claim, not checked against YouTube. The Star reports lawsuits against alleged imposters of the game, which is a different matter.]

[source: https://www.dexerto.com/roblox/tung-tung-sahur-is-at-the-center-of-a-bizarre-federal-custody-battle-over-brainrot-characters-3381733/ | id=A15-0022 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-07-01 | event=2026-06-24 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Year is inferred from the July 2026 article date. [source: https://www.dexerto.com/roblox/tung-tung-sahur-is-at-the-center-of-a-bizarre-federal-custody-battle-over-brainrot-characters-3381733/ | id=A15-0023 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-07-01 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=A party's argument in a motion to dismiss Mementum's amended counterclaims, as reported by Dexerto. [source: https://www.dexerto.com/roblox/tung-tung-sahur-is-at-the-center-of-a-bizarre-federal-custody-battle-over-brainrot-characters-3381733/ | id=A15-0024 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-07-01 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Mementum's own claim, as reported by Dexerto. ## Security and moderation

In Steal a Brainrot, Sammy deleted all the Headless Horsemen that were spawned during the October 22, 2026 hack, according to the community wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Doe_Hacking | id=A14-0001 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-10-22 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=Only the community Fandom wiki was found for this incident. Searches of news sites turned up no independent report, and the Fandom forum page could not be opened (HTTP 403).]
Tung Tung Tung Sahur was removed from Steal a Brainrot on September 13, 2025, after the developer Sammy pulled the character during licensing talks with the creator's agency. [source: https://techwiser.com/why-tung-tung-tung-sahur-removed-steal-a-brainrot/ | id=A14-0003 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | pub=2025-09-17 | event=2025-09-13 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The account of the removal comes from the creator's agency, which said the creator did not request it. The developers said in a TikTok statement that they were always open to discussion. Dataconomy reports the removal as] [source: https://dataconomy.com/2025/09/19/steal-a-brainrot-removes-tung-tung-tung-sahur-character-over-copyright | checked=2026-11-06] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | checked=2026-11-06]
The Brainrot Dealer machine in Steal a Brainrot was removed on November 15, 2025, one week after it launched on November 8, 2025, after the developer Sammy listened to player feedback. [source: https://techwiser.com/steal-a-brainrot-dealer-how-use-guide/ | id=A14-0004 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | pub=2025-11-09 | event=2025-11-15 | checked=2026-11-06 | note=The wiki says the Dealer was replaced by the Brainrot Trader and cites complaints about its fairness. The TechWiser guide was published two days after launch, so its removal date was a scheduled date and not a report of ] [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Brainrot_Dealer | checked=2026-11-06]

## Riddle and code history, more

### Codes: limited stock and riddle codes
The Steal a Brainrot code WAVERIDER4FREELOL was a limited stock code that rewarded a Waverider gear, and it is listed as expired in the August 2026 and November 2026 code lists. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Codes | id=C07-0001 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://insider-gaming.com/all-roblox-steal-a-brainrot-codes-and-rewards/ | note=Code is in the wiki Unavailable Codes table, which links the reward to the Gears page. Expired status is from Insider Gaming (dated August 8, 2026) and PocketGamer (November 2026, a model summary of the page). Dated status only, not a current check.]
The Steal a Brainrot code FREEOCTO555 was a limited stock code that rewarded an Octo Lucky Block, and it is listed as expired in the August 2026 and November 2026 code lists. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Codes | id=C07-0002 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://insider-gaming.com/all-roblox-steal-a-brainrot-codes-and-rewards/ | note=Wiki lists the code as limited stock with an Octo Lucky Block reward. Expired status is from Insider Gaming (dated August 8, 2026) and PocketGamer (November 2026, a model summary of the page). Dated status only.]
The Steal a Brainrot code BESTBRAINROTEVER was the only code listed as active on August 8, 2026, and it rewards La Vacca Saturno Saturnita. [source: https://insider-gaming.com/all-roblox-steal-a-brainrot-codes-and-rewards/ | id=C07-0004 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-08-08 | event=2026-08-08 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.dexerto.com/roblox/steal-a-brainrot-codes-3388813/ | note=Dated status, not a current one. Dexerto (November 5, 2026) also lists BESTBRAINROTEVER as active, while PocketGamer lists it as expired in November. Evidence is a quote from a model summary of the Insider Gaming page. See the Needs review conflict on this code.]
The Steal a Brainrot code PANCAKEANDSYRUP gave 10 Arca Bros and was the first way Arca Bros was obtained. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Arca_Bros | id=C07-0005 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Fandom wiki Arca Bros page only. No date given. Arca Bros is a DLC Brainrot.]
The Steal a Brainrot code SAMMYISTHEBEST spawned a La Vacca Saturno Saturnita in the server of the player who redeemed it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/La_Vacca_Saturno_Saturnita | id=C07-0006 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Fandom wiki La Vacca Saturno Saturnita page only. No date given. It is not in the wiki Codes list or the November 2026 press lists, so current status is unknown.]
### Riddles: formats and examples
Sammy's riddle codes in Steal a Brainrot have asked for a single answer typed as one code word, such as CHIMPANZINISPIDERINI, the former name of Sammyni Spyderini. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Chimpanzini_Spiderini | id=C07-0017 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Fandom wiki page only. The page does not give the riddle wording or date. The code rewarded a Pum Pum Pum.]
Sammy's Strawberry Elephant riddle in Steal a Brainrot asked for three personal facts at once: the height of the tree in his backyard, the wattage of his microwave, and the name of his 4th grade math teacher. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Strawberry_Elephant | id=C07-0018 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-10-17 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Fandom wiki page only. The wiki says the riddle was made on 17/10/26 after someone said his riddles were too easy, and it was unsolved on the page.]
The Steal a Brainrot wiki calls Sammy (SpyderSammy) Samuel Jr on its Taco Tuesday page, where it records that the Taco Tuesday that was his birthday ran the 26 event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Taco_Tuesday | id=C07-0019 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Fandom wiki Taco Tuesday page only. The wiki gives Sammy's birthday as February 25 on the SpyderSammy page and as February 24 on the Taco Tuesday and New Year's Machine pages. See open notes.]

Sammy's earliest Roblox game, Crab Game, was created and derived from the Steam game Crab Game by Daniel Sooman, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0040 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Player:SpyderSammy]
Sammy's Dig with Bombs! on Roblox is a 2025 republish of his 2023 game Dig to Win Simulator, and Roblox lists its creator as the Blue Spyder group. [source: https://games.roblox.com/v1/games?universeIds=7569134216 | id=C01-0041 | type=official | status=confirmed | confidence=high | event=2025-04-20 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Player:SpyderSammy | note=The republish link to Sammy and the 2023 date come from the Roblox wiki. The API date is the Dig with Bombs! creation date.]
Sammy's Dig with Bombs! on Roblox had 1,035,103 visits on November 7, 2026. [source: https://games.roblox.com/v1/games?universeIds=7569134216 | id=C01-0042 | type=official | status=confirmed | confidence=high | event=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Sammy's socials
Sammy's personal YouTube channel is @SpyderSammy, which he mainly uses to talk to YouTubers through streams, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Socials | id=C01-0053 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Fandom wiki warns that there are many Sammy impersonators on social media. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Socials | id=C01-0054 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Player:SpyderSammy]
The official Steal a Brainrot Discord invite listed on the Fandom Socials page for Sammy is discord.com/invite/brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Socials | id=C01-0055 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy's Steal a Brainrot Instagram account, _stealabrainrot__, had hardly posted because it was new, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Socials | id=C01-0056 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Admin Abuse and Taco Tuesday
The Brainrots Sammy spawns most often during Admin Abuses in Steal a Brainrot are Matteo, La Vacca Saturno Saturnita, Karkerkar Kurkur, Dul Dul Dul, Los Tralaleritos, Las Tralaleritas, Job Job Job Sahur, Graipuss Medussi, To to to Sahur and Chicleteira Bicicleteira, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse | id=C01-0057 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy may spawn Gattatino Nyanino and Unclito Samito during Admin Abuses in Steal a Brainrot, but they are not guaranteed, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse | id=C01-0058 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy always spawns Lucky Blocks during Admin Abuses in Steal a Brainrot, including the Mythic, Brainrot God, Taco, Los Taco Blocks, Admin, Los and Secret Lucky Blocks, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse | id=C01-0059 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki lists the guaranteed blocks as Mythic, Brainrot God, Taco, Los Taco Blocks, Admin, Los Lucky Blocks and Secret.]
In Secret Admin Abuses in Steal a Brainrot, Sammy runs luck multipliers such as 10x, 12x and 20x, because fewer players are active and the economy is less affected, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse | id=C01-0060 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy activated the Fishing Event on April 19, 2026, for Cyber Fishing in a Secret Admin Abuse in Steal a Brainrot, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse | id=C01-0061 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-04-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy spawns events such as the Indonesian Event, the Mexico Event, the Brazil Event and a Concert Event during Admin Abuses in Steal a Brainrot, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse | id=C01-0062 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy used the concept of Admin Abuse in Steal a Brainrot, though the idea was invented earlier and became well known in 2024 and 2025, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0063 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse]
### Fat Sammy and Sammy's Base
Sammy's Fat Sammy event in Steal a Brainrot was revealed on February 21, 2026 to have his own Brainrot, Sammyni Fattini. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fat_Sammy | id=C01-0064 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-02-21 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy first forgot to spawn Fat Sammy on the March 17, 2026 Taco Tuesday in Steal a Brainrot, after which Fat Sammy spawned only rarely. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fat_Sammy | id=C01-0065 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-17 | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, Fat Sammy's stomach gets larger as players feed him Brainrots with the Taco trait, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fat_Sammy | id=C01-0066 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy's Base in Steal a Brainrot is a three-floor base that was formerly two floors, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0068 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Brainrots in Sammy's Base in Steal a Brainrot can have mutations but cannot have traits, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0069 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy usually updates his new base in Steal a Brainrot to match the current mutation, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0070 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Fandom wiki says Sammy either forgot to change his base to the Celestial mutation or chose not to, so no Celestial base skin existed in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0071 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy added the Mexican Eagle from Mexico's flag to the top-floor window of Sammy's Base for the 5th of May, Cinco de Mayo, in Steal a Brainrot, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0072 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The Fandom wiki does not give a year for the May 5 base change.]
Sammy's Base in Steal a Brainrot has a gaming setup similar to the one in the Admin Abuse War cutscene, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0073 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Admin_Abuse]
Steak, Caylus and Rustynickle40 each had their own version of Sammy's Base during their own Admin Abuses in Steal a Brainrot, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammy%27s_Base | id=C01-0074 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Leaks
Sammy leaked Traits for Steal a Brainrot in June 2025, according to the Fandom wiki's leak gallery. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Leaks | id=C01-0075 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy confirmed the comeback of Coffin Tung Tung Tung Sahur in Steal a Brainrot in a November 2025 leak, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Leaks | id=C01-0076 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy uploaded a GIF in December 2025 to confirm that Skibidi Toilet was upcoming in Steal a Brainrot, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Leaks | id=C01-0077 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-12 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Sammy's statements and personal details
Sammy once wrote in his own Steal a Brainrot Discord server that he was somewhere in north Africa, according to the Fandom wiki, which also says his nationality is unknown. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0078 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Recorded as a statement he made, not as a verified location.]
The Fandom wiki says Sammy's nationality is unknown. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0079 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Fandom wiki infobox lists Sammy, the Steal a Brainrot developer, as 24 years old. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0081 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki gives no date for the age.]
Sammy has made several references to Brazil, according to the Fandom wiki, and his group is named BRAZILIAN SPYDER. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0082 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/BRAZILIAN_SPYDER]
The Fandom wiki says Sammy keeps track of the wiki and asks people to type only nice things about him. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/SpyderSammy | id=C01-0083 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Do Small and co-creators
Sammy's co-creator Do Small created the do_small account on Christmas 2020, according to the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Do_Small | id=C01-0084 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Fortnite and Developini
Developini Braziliaspidini, a Sammy-themed Brainrot for Steal a Brainrot, is listed as a hoax on the Fandom wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Developini_Braziliaspidini | id=C01-0086 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Spyder_Family]
Sammyni Spyderini was the first Spyder Brainrot ever added to Steal a Brainrot, according to the Fandom Spyder Family page. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Spyder_Family | id=C01-0087 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]

### Rebirths
Rebirth 13 in Steal a Brainrot required 35T cash and the Ballerino Lololo Brainrot, according to the Update 9 wiki page. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_09 | id=C02-0377 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-07-25 | checked=2026-11-07]
Rebirth 13 in Steal a Brainrot gave a x12 multiplier and a 1B cash bonus, according to the Update 9 wiki page. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_09 | id=C02-0378 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-07-25 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Machines
The Craft Machine was removed from Steal a Brainrot in Update 20 on October 11, 2025, in the same update that added Witch Fuse. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_20 | id=C02-0379 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Divine Fuse Machine replaced the Fuse Machine in Steal a Brainrot in Update 41 on March 7, 2026. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_41 | id=C02-0381 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-07 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The Divine Fuse page gives 2/28/2026 for the same change. See open notes.]
Sammy announced the Trade Machine as a poll on January 22, 2026, in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Trade_Machine | id=C02-0383 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-01-22 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Date from the Trade Machine wiki page. The machine was released in Update 39.]
The Trade Machine was the 13th machine in Steal a Brainrot, according to the Steal a Brainrot wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Trade_Machine | id=C02-0384 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki trivia count.]
### Trade Plaza
The Trade Plaza in Steal a Brainrot lets players trade Brainrots, Bases and Gears, and players cannot steal inside it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Trade_Plaza | id=C02-0386 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-06-20 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Mutations
Sammy ran Mutation rain during Update 49 in Steal a Brainrot on May 2, 2026, replacing the random carpet mutation every 25 Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_49 | id=C02-0387 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-05-02 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Conflicts with the Update 51 claim that Mutation Rain was added then.]
### Traits
Traits were introduced in Steal a Brainrot in Update 5 on June 28, 2025 as special add-ons from events that add income on top of the mutation multiplier. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_05 | id=C02-0388 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-06-28 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Lucky Blocks
The Radioactive Secret Lucky Block in Steal a Brainrot had a 0.5% chance from the roulette and was added in Update 25 on November 15, 2025. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_25 | id=C02-0389 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-11-15 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Bases
Completing 23 of the 25 Aquatic Index Brainrots (90%) earned an Aquatic base in Steal a Brainrot, added in Update 25 on November 15, 2025. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Log/Update_25 | id=C02-0390 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-11-15 | checked=2026-11-07]

### Machines overview
Machines in Steal a Brainrot are core features, and every few months a new machine is released that replaces the previous one. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Machines | id=C09-0820 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Machines page of the Steal a Brainrot wiki says Cupid's Machine needs two Brainrots put in to match a specific combination for a different reward. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Machines | id=C09-0821 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Craft Machine takes 2 to 4 Brainrots as input depending on the recipe. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Machines | id=C09-0822 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Brainrot Trader takes 1 to 5 Brainrots as input depending on the recipe. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Machines | id=C09-0823 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Witch Fuse and Santa's Fuse and Divine Fuse each take 4 Brainrots as input, per the Machines page. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Machines | id=C09-0824 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Machines page of the Steal a Brainrot wiki lists the Rainbow Machine as in game only if Sammy activates it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Machines | id=C09-0825 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Table cell on Machines page.]
### Rainbow Machine
The Rainbow Machine in Steal a Brainrot was the first machine added to the game, and it was the first machine to spawn an event without being an admin abuse. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine | id=C09-0827 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Rainbow Machine was teased to need 100 Gold Brainrots, but the final release needed only 25 Gold Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine | id=C09-0828 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, a Rainbow Tralalero Tralala stood next to the Rainbow Machine during the Rainbow Machine update, and after the Bloodmoon update it was replaced by a Bloodrot Ballerina Cappuccina. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine | id=C09-0829 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Evidence text in wiki reads: after the Blood Moon update, the Tralalero was replaced by a Bloodrot Ballerina Cappuccina.]
The Rainbow Machine event in Steal a Brainrot was added as part of Update 4, and the Rainbow Machine is currently unavailable. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine_Event | id=C09-0830 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Conflict: the Rainbow Machine page says it was added June 21, 2025 (Saturday); this event page says June 20, 2025. The event page also says Replaced by the Bubblegum Machine, which conflicts with the Bubblegum page.]
The Rainbow Machine in Steal a Brainrot is currently unavailable and can only be spawned by admins, and only the rainbow visual appears. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine | id=C09-0831 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Bubblegum Machine
The Bubblegum Machine in Steal a Brainrot was the first and only machine not positioned on the right side of the shop. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bubblegum_Machine | id=C09-0832 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Bubblegum Machine in Steal a Brainrot was the first trait machine, and its Bubblegum trait was given to random Brainrots walking down the carpet. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bubblegum_Machine | id=C09-0833 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Bubblegum Machine in Steal a Brainrot was replaced by the Fuse Machine, because the Candy Brainrots it needed were replaced by Lava Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bubblegum_Machine | id=C09-0834 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Bubblegum Machine in Steal a Brainrot can only be spawned by the Admin Machine and by admins now. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bubblegum_Machine | id=C09-0835 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Fuse Machine
The Fuse Machine in Steal a Brainrot was added on Friday, August 1, 2025, and it stood next to the Coin Shop. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0836 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Single wiki source in this session. Conflicting release days exist (see Needs review); Sportskeeda and The Game of Nerds are cited there.]
The Fuse Machine in Steal a Brainrot takes 4 Brainrots as input and combines them into one Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0837 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Fuse Machine averages the rarities of its 4 inputs with Common as 1 and Secret as 7 to choose the Dominant Rarity of the result. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0838 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Fuse Machine gives a chance of at least 10 percent to get a Brainrot one rarity above the Dominant Rarity, and up to 50 percent when all inputs are better Brainrots of that rarity. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0839 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The 2025 Fuse Machine in Steal a Brainrot was removed on Saturday, September 6, 2025, and replaced by the Craft Machine. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0840 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The 2026 Fuse Machine in Steal a Brainrot added 8 new Mythic to Secret Brainrots when it returned on January 24, 2026, and it brought back the Common to Legendary Brainrots of the 2025 Fuse Machine. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0841 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the 2026 Fuse Machine replaced Bacuru and Egguru with Los 67 and replaced Hydra Dragon Cannelloni with Cerberus on February 24, 2026, Sammy's birthday. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0842 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Fuse Machine on its first 2 weeks let players fuse 4 Mythic Brainrots with no chance of a Mythic result, a bug that was patched later. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0843 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy teased on December 27, 2025 that the Fuse Machine might return for New Year's, but he decided against it because its Brainrots would be worthless. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0844 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy said on January 3, 2026 that the Fuse Machine was never coming back in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0845 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The 2026 Fuse Machine in Steal a Brainrot remained for about a month, almost surpassing the 5 weeks the original OG fuse stayed. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Fuse_Machine | id=C09-0846 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Craft Machine
The 2026 Craft Machine in Steal a Brainrot was the machine with the shortest lifetime in the game, lasting only 3 weeks. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Craft_Machine | id=C09-0847 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Craft Machine in Steal a Brainrot is a light purple machine with cables, yellow, red and white buttons, a lever, and a satellite above the craft pad. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Craft_Machine | id=C09-0848 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, Craft Machine Brainrots Antonio, Elefanto Frigo, Signore Carapace and Tirilikalika Tirilikalako were buffed to Secret rarity on February 28, 2026, four months after they were made. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Craft_Machine | id=C09-0849 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy said Update 66 would bring the OG Craft Machine back to Steal a Brainrot with different Brainrots, similar to the Fuse Machine return. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Craft_Machine | id=C09-0850 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Witch Fuse
The Witch Fuse in Steal a Brainrot is the first fuse machine to include an OG Brainrot, which was Headless Horseman after it was buffed from Secret. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Witch_Fuse | id=C09-0851 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Witch Fuse in Steal a Brainrot was first set to be removed at 1:00PM EST on November 8, 2025, and was moved to the 3:00PM EST Brainrot Dealer update. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Witch_Fuse | id=C09-0852 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy activated the Witch Fuse luck at 12:00 PM EST on November 8, 2025 in Steal a Brainrot, before the Admin Abuse that day. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Witch_Fuse | id=C09-0853 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Divine Fuse
The Divine Fuse in Steal a Brainrot is the second machine based on a seasonal mutation instead of a seasonal event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Divine_Fuse | id=C09-0854 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Summer Fuse
The Summer Fuse in Steal a Brainrot has a beige sand castle where Brainrots appear when opened, a sea-blue side, two parasols and corals above the Fuse. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Summer_Fuse | id=C09-0855 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Summer Fuse in Steal a Brainrot was the longest running machine ever with about 2 months before it was removed. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Summer_Fuse | id=C09-0856 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Haunted Fuse
The Haunted Fuse in Steal a Brainrot was teased one week before its October 3, 2026 release, when it was in game but blackened and not usable. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Haunted_Fuse | id=C09-0857 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Haunted Fuse in Steal a Brainrot readded Tartaragno, Pinealotto Fruttarino, Mummio Rappitto, Quackula, Buho De Fuego and Magi Ribbitini. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Haunted_Fuse | id=C09-0858 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Haunted Fuse in Steal a Brainrot has an animation where the fuse eats the Brainrots put in it, and it makes a wicked laughter sound when it comes out. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Haunted_Fuse | id=C09-0859 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### La Craft Machine

### Limited Quantity Brainrots
Perrito Burrito in Steal a Brainrot was added on September 30, 2025 with 2,500,000 stock, which the wiki's Perrito Burrito page says is the most stock of any Limited Quantity Brainrot, and it was sold from the Taco Truck while it had stock. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Perrito_Burrito | id=C13-0495 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Conflicts with the Tacorita Bicicleta page, which says Tacorillo Crocodillo had the most stock.]
Chillin Chili and Perrito Burrito were both obtainable from the Taco Truck on Taco Tuesday, September 30, 2025 in Steal a Brainrot, the first time the Taco Truck was stocked with two different Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Chillin_Chili | id=C13-0496 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Tacorillo Crocodillo in Steal a Brainrot was first stocked with 1,000,000 units in the Taco Truck, and it was taken off the Taco Truck when about 400,000 were still in stock. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Tacorillo_Crocodillo | id=C13-0497 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-03 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki says SpyderSammy removed it while it was still in stock, mainly so La Lucky Grande could take its place.]
Nacho Spyder in Steal a Brainrot was leaked by Sammy (SpyderSammy) on March 3, 2026 at 1:04 PM EST and released three hours later alongside Tacorillo Crocodillo, as one of two Limited Quantity Brainrots added during the March 3, 2026 Taco Tuesday Admin Abuse. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Nacho_Spyder | id=C13-0498 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
Steakini Fattini in Steal a Brainrot was stocked with 50,000 units at the start and another 50,000 after the first stock ran out, according to the community wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Steakini_Fattini | id=C13-0499 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-05-30 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki says the first stock was accidentally set to 5 instead of 50,000 by Steak.]
Steakini Fattini in Steal a Brainrot was first stocked at 5 instead of 50,000 because Steak accidentally entered the wrong number, according to the community wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Caylusaurus | id=C13-0501 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The 100,000 figure is labeled as an estimate on the wiki.]

### Extinct Event
The Extinct Event in Steal a Brainrot spawned one of three Extinct Brainrots every two hours, and collecting all three let players turn them in to Archeologist Sammy to trigger La Extinct Grande. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Extinct | id=C13-0519 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | event=2025-09-13 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Source is the community wiki Extinct page. The existing sheet has a fact about the Red Carpet spawn; this one adds the Archeologist trigger.]
Extinct Ballerina in Steal a Brainrot was brought back for the Jump for Eggs limited time mode, and Extinct Tralalero can be obtained from Fishing, while Extinct Matteo and La Extinct Grande are still fully unobtainable, according to the community wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Extinct | id=C13-0520 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki trivia line. The date the Jump for Eggs return happened is not on this page.]
La Extinct Grande in Steal a Brainrot was the first Brainrot in the game with a fixed global stock limit, according to the community wiki's Extinct page. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Extinct | id=C13-1152 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki trivia line on the Extinct page.]

Bling Luming in Steal a Brainrot is obtained from the Red Carpet and is credited to BRAZILIAN SPYDER. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bling_Luming | id=C03-0005 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]

## Game mechanics in detail

### Mutations
Gold is the most common mutation in Steal a Brainrot, and Diamond is the second most common. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0001 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
In Steal a Brainrot, Gold, Diamond and Rainbow are not tied to any event because they naturally occur on Brainrots arriving on the conveyor, while mutations such as Galaxy and Yin Yang can only be obtained from events. [source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot | id=C04-0002 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-06-29 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations]
In Steal a Brainrot, a Gold mutation has a 10% chance to spawn on the Red Carpet and a Diamond mutation has a 5% chance. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0003 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Fandom mutation table gives 10% for Gold and 5% for Diamond.]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Rainbow mutation has a 1% spawn chance on the Red Carpet, and that chance increases during the Rainbow Machine Event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0004 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot | note=The Sportskeeda article confirms the Rainbow admin event raises its spawn chance.]
The Bloodrot mutation in Steal a Brainrot is a 2x mutation that turns a Brainrot dark red and is unobtainable without Admin Abuse, with a mild chance during the Bloodmoon event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0005 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Bloodrot mutation was the first mutation in Steal a Brainrot that had a limited event, according to the Mutations trivia. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0006 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The same page says Bloodrot has been in the game since Update 2, which conflicts with Gold and Diamond being first.]
The Candy mutation in Steal a Brainrot turns a Brainrot pink, gives a 4x multiplier, and has a mild chance to apply during the Candy Aurora event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0007 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Lava mutation in Steal a Brainrot turns a Brainrot neon orange, gives a 6x multiplier, and was formerly activated every 1/3 hours. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0008 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Galaxy mutation in Steal a Brainrot turns a Brainrot neon purple, gives a 7x multiplier, and was the last mutation that was formerly activated every 1/3 hours. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0009 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Yin Yang mutation in Steal a Brainrot turns a Brainrot black and white, gives a 7.5x multiplier, and was formerly activated every 1/2 hours. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0010 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Radioactive mutation in Steal a Brainrot gives an 8.5x multiplier, turns a Brainrot neon green and applies a hatch texture to it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0011 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Cursed mutation in Steal a Brainrot gives a 9x multiplier and gives a Brainrot red eyes, similar to the Tung Tung Attack trait. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0012 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Divine mutation in Steal a Brainrot gives a 10x multiplier, turns a Brainrot bright yellow and white, and is the only mutation that comes with a chance at the exclusive Halo trait. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0013 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot , https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Traits/Seasonal | note=Halo is the only event trait that comes alongside a mutation, per the Traits trivia.]
The Cyber mutation in Steal a Brainrot gives an 11x multiplier, turns a Brainrot black and blue, and makes parts of it transparent or cybernetic. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0014 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Phantom mutation in Steal a Brainrot gives a 12x multiplier and makes a Brainrot a transparent black that flashes in and out of transparency. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0015 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot]
The Crystal mutation in Steal a Brainrot turns a Brainrot purple and blue with white parts and flashing effects. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0016 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Crystal's 13x and release are already in the sheet; this adds the look.]
The Eclipse mutation in Steal a Brainrot turns a Brainrot black with yellow eyes and legs and a bright sun above it, and was called Celestial before release. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0017 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Eclipse_Event | note=The Eclipse Event page gives the mutation 13.5x in its trivia, while the Mutations page gives 14x.]
Mutation Rain is an Admin Abuse command in Steal a Brainrot that guarantees a set number of Brainrots spawn with a random mutation, and it was first added in Update 51 to celebrate the game's anniversary. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0018 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Disco was planned as the mutation that would come after Divine in Steal a Brainrot, but Sammy scrapped it and added the Cyber mutation instead. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0019 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Frost was planned as the mutation that would come after Phantom in Steal a Brainrot, but Sammy dismissed it and added the Crystal mutation instead. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0020 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Cyber mutation in Steal a Brainrot was added after the YouTuber and streamer Rustynickle40 proposed the idea during a video or stream. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0021 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
When the Divine event was first released in Steal a Brainrot, Sammy accidentally spawned Cursed mutations instead of Divine ones. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0022 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, a Brainrot's mutation multiplier is applied to its base income first, and each trait multiplier is then added on top. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0023 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/steal-brainrot-all-traits-multipliers | note=Evidence is the start of the formula in the Mutations math block.]
In Steal a Brainrot, a Ventoliero Pavonero making 65M per second with a Cyber mutation and one fire trait makes about 1.04B per second, because its multiplier becomes 16x. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0024 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Worked example from the Mutations page.]
Starting with the Radioactive mutation, Brainrots affected by the seasonal mutations in Steal a Brainrot have a special texture applied to them. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0025 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Divine mutation in Steal a Brainrot could be obtained from the Divine Fuse Machine as well as during the Divine event, according to Sportskeeda. [source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot | id=C04-0026 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-06-29 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | note=Sportskeeda says it used to be obtainable this way, so the Divine Fuse route may be gone.]
The Cyber mutation in Steal a Brainrot could be obtained from the Cyber Craft Machine and during the Cyber event, according to Sportskeeda. [source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot | id=C04-0027 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-06-29 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations]
The Sportskeeda mutation guide from June 2026 calls Phantom the best mutation in Steal a Brainrot, but Crystal and Eclipse were added later. [source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot | id=C04-0028 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-06-29 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | note=Superseded by the later mutations.]
Sportskeeda lists a Celestial mutation in Steal a Brainrot with a 4x multiplier that only the developers could activate, separate from the later Eclipse mutation. [source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-mutations-effects-steal-brainrot | id=C04-0029 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-06-29 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Sportskeeda's Celestial and the Fandom Eclipse (formerly Celestial) disagree. See open notes.]

In Steal a Brainrot, traits stack by adding their multipliers together, so a Brainrot God with both the Zombie and Firework traits has a combined 11x multiplier before any mutation. [source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/steal-brainrot-all-traits-multipliers | id=C04-0078 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-03 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | note=The wiki formula shows traits added to the 1x base (1x + 5x = 6x), so stacking is additive. Some other guides call it multiplicative.]
The Steal a Brainrot Wiki says the mutation multiplier and trait multipliers are added together, so a Default Ventoliero Pavonero with fire and nyan traits has an 11x multiplier. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Mutations | id=C04-0079 | type=community | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/steal-brainrot-all-traits-multipliers]
