## Meme origins and real-world references

### Italian brainrot trend
Italian brainrot, the trend behind many Steal a Brainrot Brainrots, went viral on TikTok and Instagram partly because of its synthesized Italian voiceovers. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0001 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia lists several viral causes; this record names only the voiceover element.]
Fans of Italian brainrot, whose characters include Steal a Brainrot Brainrots, have written stories about its characters, which Wikipedia calls a form of internet folklore. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0002 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Hungarian prime minister Viktor Orban posted a TikTok video showing a 3D model of Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, dancing in a government meeting. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0003 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia's text gives the name as Viktor Orbán; the accent is kept in the alias.]
A meme coin called Italianrot, inspired by Italian brainrot characters that include Steal a Brainrot Brainrots, was launched in March 2025. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0004 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-03 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia says only that Italian brainrot inspired the coin. The coin's own page was not read.]
In Italy, several newsstands began selling Skifidol Italian Brainrot Trading Card Games, which were inspired by the memes behind Steal a Brainrot Brainrots. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0005 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Panini released an Italian brainrot sticker album in 2025, the same meme that gave Steal a Brainrot many of its Brainrot characters. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0006 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia does not say which characters are on the stickers, so no character list is recorded.]
The original audio for Tralalero Tralala, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, includes blasphemy against God, which led some Muslim TikTok users to speak against the Italian brainrot trend. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0007 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia also says some people argue blasphemy is used as casual filler in Italian and that there was no anti-religious intent.]
Bombardiro Crocodilo, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, has been criticized for making light of alleged war crimes in the Gaza war, because some videos describe him bombing civilians there. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0008 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/bombardiro-crocodilo-italian-brainrot]
### Tung Tung Tung Sahur origin and dispute
Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is counted as Italian brainrot but has Indonesian origin. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0009 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tung-tung-tung-sahur]
Fortnite uploaded a trailer on March 18, 2026, confirming that Tung Tung Tung Sahur and Ballerina Cappuccina, both Steal a Brainrot Brainrots, would be Fortnite cosmetics. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0011 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-18 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | note=Wikipedia is the only source read for the trailer date. Fortnite's own page was not read.]
An Indonesian film production company, formerly called K2K Pictures, was rumored to be developing a film about Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, and the company denied it. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0012 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia gives only the company's former name; the current name is blank in the article.]
Noxa, the creator of Tung Tung Tung Sahur, objected to a Tung Tung Tung Sahur-like character used without permission in the battle royale game Free Fire. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0013 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Mementum Lab published a legal filing listing the DALL-E prompts Noxa used to create the original image of Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0014 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia spells the agency Mementum Lab. The Needs review section records a different spelling in other sources; that conflict is not reopened here.]
Mementum Lab argued that Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, did not come from a single prompt, because Noxa went through numerous iterations. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0015 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is ineligible for copyright protection because it comes from an AI-generated image, according to Wikipedia. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0016 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wikipedia says legal proceedings are continuing. This states the article's position, not a court ruling.]
The Tung Tung Tung Sahur image was posted in the Anomali AI character trend, an Indonesian trend inspired by Italian brainrot, which is where the Steal a Brainrot Brainrot's style comes from. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0017 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The word tung in Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, also means rumbling in Sundanese, a language spoken in Indonesia. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0018 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Indonesian police in Jombang, East Java, set up a police post themed on Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, to encourage drivers to rest during mudik. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur | id=C08-0019 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The evidence is an image caption in the article. The post's date is not stated.]
Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is also known by the nickname Triple T. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tung-tung-tung-sahur | id=C08-0020 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur]
### Italian Brainrot characters
Ballerina Cappuccina, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, has a sister named Espressona Signora, according to Wikipedia. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | id=C08-0010 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The sister's name is in bold in the wikitext; the name is taken from that sentence.]
The earliest found Bombardiro Crocodilo video, which features a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, was posted on TikTok on February 20, 2025, by user @armenjiharhanyan. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/bombardiro-crocodilo-italian-brainrot | id=C08-0021 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=medium | event=2025-02-20 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_brainrot | note=Know Your Meme says the exact origin of the first Bombardiro Crocodilo meme is unknown. The creator handle is in the same passage but not in the evidence snippet.]
The Bombardiro Crocodilo narration, which voices the Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, rhymes words in a way similar to the French meme Bitcoin Burger IbraTV. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/bombardiro-crocodilo-italian-brainrot | id=C08-0022 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Bombombini Gusini, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, was first posted by TikToker @armenjiharhanyan in early March 2025, the same creator who first shared Bombardiro Crocodilo. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/bombombini-gusini | id=C08-0023 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | event=2025-03-05 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Bombombini_Gusini | note=Know Your Meme dates the video to March 5, 2025 in its origin section.]
Ballerina Cappuccina, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, was first posted on TikTok on March 19, 2025, by the account @aironic.fun. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/ballerina-cappuccina-italian-brainrot | id=C08-0024 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-03-19 | checked=2026-11-07 | also=https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Ballerina_Cappuccina | note=Know Your Meme names @aironic.fun. The Steal a Brainrot wiki infobox lists @aironicfun, which is a spelling conflict in the open notes.]
The original Ballerina Cappuccina video, which introduced a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, garnered over 19.5 million views and 2.2 million likes in three weeks. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/ballerina-cappuccina-italian-brainrot | id=C08-0025 | type=secondary | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The name cappuccina in Ballerina Cappuccina refers to cappuccino coffee, since the Steal a Brainrot Brainrot is a ballet dancer with a cappuccino cup for a head. [source: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/ballerina-cappuccina-italian-brainrot | id=C08-0026 | type=secondary | status=corroborated | confidence=high | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Know Your Meme describes the character as a hybrid of a ballet dancer and a cup of cappuccino. The word link to the coffee drink is the page's own description.]
In the original Ballerina Cappuccina narration, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, the voice says she is the wife of Cappuccino Assassino. The meme coin $CHILLGUY, inspired by Chill Guy, rose in part after Salvadorian president Nayib Bukele posted about it on Twitter, and Banks then copyrighted the artwork. Granny, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is based on the 2025 song Bazooka by Miami XO, which is about a grandmother hit by a bazooka. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Granny | id=C08-0061 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Griffin, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is based on the mythological griffin, with an eagle head and a lion's torso and legs. Chicken Zombie, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, references Chicken Jockey from Minecraft, the Chicken Jockey meme from the Minecraft Movie, and the Chicken Zombie pet from Grow a Garden. ### Roblox legends
Noobini Pizzanini, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is visually based on the classic R6 rig of the Roblox Noob avatar, with a pizza on its head. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Noobini_Pizzanini | id=C08-0065 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The sound of 1x1x1x1, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, erroneously says 1x1x1x1x1 instead of its original name. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=C08-0067 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Fans of the Roblox game Forsaken, which also has a 1x1x1x1 character, believed Steal a Brainrot's 1x1x1x1 was copied from it, though the 1x1x1x1 myth was on Roblox for years before Forsaken. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=C08-0068 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki's claim that 1x1x1x1 predates Forsaken is its own statement and was not checked against Roblox sources.]
John Doe, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, comes from one of two Roblox test accounts, the other being Jane Doe. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Doe | id=C08-0069 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Players speculated that John Doe, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, would hack all of Roblox on March 18, a date Roblox itself denied. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Doe | id=C08-0070 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Guest 666, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is based on the Roblox myth of the same name and was featured in a YouTube animated series by ObliviousHD. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Guest_666 | id=C08-0073 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]

Chicleteira Bicicleteira, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, is a Brazilian brainrot created by the TikTok account @brainbenderchannel, making it the first Brazilian brainrot in the game. La Vacca Saturno Saturnita, a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot, was buffed three times, the last time because Dumborino Miracello was earning more than it. ## Sounds, secrets and scrapped content in detail

### OG spawn themes
Happy Strawberry is the main soundtrack of the Strawberry Elephant event in Steal a Brainrot, and it plays when a Strawberry Elephant spawns, which players rarely hear. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Soundtracks/OGs | id=C15-0001 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Meowl's Forest is the main soundtrack of the Meowl event in Steal a Brainrot, and it plays when Meowl spawns, which players rarely hear. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Soundtracks/OGs | id=C15-0002 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
John Pork Is Calling is the main soundtrack of the John Pork event in Steal a Brainrot, and it plays when John Pork spawns. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Soundtracks/OGs | id=C15-0003 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Infectious Skibidi is the main soundtrack of the Skibidi Toilet event in Steal a Brainrot, and it plays when Skibidi Toilet spawns. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Soundtracks/OGs | id=C15-0004 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
### Ritual soundtracks
Underwater is the main soundtrack of the underwater events in Steal a Brainrot, heard after the Los Orcalitos ritual or when Sammy activates it, and it cannot play during an admin abuse while another event is running. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Soundtracks/Rituals | id=C15-0005 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]

Clicking the harp that rarely spawns on the Divine island during the Eggrot Hunt in Steal a Brainrot gives a 100 percent chance of getting Hydra Bunny. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Eggrot_Hunt | id=C15-0098 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, equipping Coil Combo, Gravity Coil or Candy Coils and jumping at the same time lets players reach Divine Island without maxing out their jumps. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Eggrot_Hunt | id=C15-0099 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Backrooms Event in Steal a Brainrot has Evil Sammy guards, whose designs are based on SpyderSammy and an Arachne fusion. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Backrooms_Event | id=C15-0100 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
A fan-made Brainrot called Tamaluk un Meass was a hoax in Steal a Brainrot, and its wiki article was created on September 13, 2025. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Tamaluk_un_Meass | id=C15-0101 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2025-09-13 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki says the Brainrot was a fan-made hoax and that Do Big Studios affiliates commented on it.]
In Steal a Brainrot's Trick or Treat event, the trait was the Jack O'Lantern Pet, and players got the most Candy Corn by visiting every door in rotation as fast as possible. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Trick_or_Treating | id=C15-0103 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Sari is the Steal a Brainrot player who hosted a secret Admin Abuse for Japan and has his own snap. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sari | id=C15-0104 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
Steak's Steal a Brainrot Admin Abuse featured fake rare Brainrots, including Bloodrot Strawberry Elephant, Radioactive Headless Horseman and Yin Yang Strawberry Elephant, that vanished when streamers collected the money. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Steak's_Admin_Abuse | id=C15-0105 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Meowl event in Steal a Brainrot was activated by Sammy on purpose for 2 seconds as a joke on February 24, 2026, during Taco Tuesday. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Meowl_Event | id=C15-0106 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-02-24 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Strawberry Event in Steal a Brainrot was also activated by Sammy as a joke on February 24, 2026, during Taco Tuesday, lasting 2 seconds. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Strawberry_Event | id=C15-0107 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-02-24 | checked=2026-11-07]
The John Doe Hacking in Steal a Brainrot on March 18, 2026 is tied to a 2017 rumor that the John Doe account would hack Roblox on March 18. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/John_Doe_Hacking | id=C15-0108 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | event=2026-03-18 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Removed and unused content
Crocodildo Penisini was a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot planned for the Fuse Machine, but its model was never shown in the game and it was removed because its name relates to NSFW content. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Removed_Content | id=C15-0109 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki says it appeared only as an invisible name tag in its planned form.]
Gattatino Neonino was a Steal a Brainrot Brainrot that was meant to replace Gattatino Nyanino and was removed, according to the wiki, after Nyan Cat creator Chris Torres permitted use of the meme. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Removed_Content | id=C15-0110 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki's reasoning is ambiguous. Treat as a wiki claim.]
The Rainbow Machine in Steal a Brainrot needed 25 Gold Brainrots in the final release, but the teaser showed 100 Gold Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine | id=C15-0111 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
In Steal a Brainrot, the Tralalero that stood next to the Rainbow Machine was replaced by a Bloodrot Ballerina Cappuccina after the Blood Moon update. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Machine | id=C15-0112 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]
The Easter Eventboard in Steal a Brainrot originally started events every hour, and this was changed to every 2 hours. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Easter_Eventboard | id=C15-0113 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | checked=2026-11-07]

## Brainrot details from wiki pages

# One subsection per Brainrot, from the trivia, look and obtaining parts of its wiki page, read on 2026-11-07. Lines the sheet already had were left out.
### 1x1x1x1
1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot is based on a Roblox myth about an alternative account of former Roblox admin Shedletsky. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0001 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Roblox myth behind 1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot claimed he was a hacker, and Roblox itself said so in avatar item descriptions for lore purposes before the account was terminated. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0002 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Lore claim from the wiki's account of the Roblox myth.]
The sound of 1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot erroneously says 1x1x1x1x1 instead of his original name, which has an extra x1. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0003 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
Guest 666 in Steal a Brainrot makes $65,555,555/s more income than 1x1x1x1, and John Doe makes $6.388.889/s more, as the wiki writes it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0004 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki writes John Doe's figure as $6.388.889/s, probably meaning 6,388,889 (7.5M minus 1.1M).]
The original income of 1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot when expanded is $1,111,111/s, which the game shortens to $1.1M/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0005 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
The 1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot caused controversy because the Roblox game Forsaken also uses 1x1x1x1 as a character, and its fanbase thought Steal a Brainrot copied it, though the myth predates Forsaken. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0006 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot has red eyes with white pupils, and a zipper that connects to his mouth closes his grin. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0007 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot wields the Daemonshank and wears a Viridian Domino Crown. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0008 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
1x1x1x1 in Steal a Brainrot was once in the craft recipe of La Anniversary Grande, and people overpaid for it during that time. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/1x1x1x1 | id=B1-0009 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-19 | checked=2026-11-07]
### 25
25 in Steal a Brainrot costs $600M, formerly $250M, and makes $2.5M/s, formerly $1M/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/25 | id=B1-0010 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki gives the former values without dates.]
25 in Steal a Brainrot makes $2.5M/s because its name is 25 with a decimal point. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/25 | id=B1-0011 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
25 in Steal a Brainrot cannot get Mutations or Traits, and neither can Please my Present or Bunnyman, because they spawn on the base after being claimed from the Advent Calendar. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/25 | id=B1-0012 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
25 in Steal a Brainrot represents the 25th day of December, which is Christmas. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/25 | id=B1-0013 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
25 in Steal a Brainrot is obtained from the Advent Calendar after logging in for 25 days straight, and is now unobtainable. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/25 | id=B1-0014 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
### 4th Bros
4th Bros in Steal a Brainrot is the first instance of a baby Unclito Samito and a baby Pop Pop Sahur. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0015 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Unclito Samito in 4th Bros in Steal a Brainrot has a beard, even though he is supposed to be a child. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0016 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
4th Bros in Steal a Brainrot is needed to craft Bufalino Boomberino, along with 67 and Money Money Puggy. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0017 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
4th Bros in Steal a Brainrot was spawned only once and will never spawn again, like Brunito Marsito and Flancito. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0018 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Pop Pop Sahur in 4th Bros in Steal a Brainrot represents the fireworks of July 4th, the Independence Day of the USA. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0019 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
4th Bros in Steal a Brainrot makes $3.38M/s more than the brainrots inside it, which the wiki puts at $370K/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0020 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Pop Pop Sahur and Unclito Samito are Brainrot Gods on their own in Steal a Brainrot but are Secret inside 4th Bros, which the wiki says is common for Los Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/4th_Bros | id=B1-0021 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
### 67
67 in Steal a Brainrot is based on the 67 meme, which features a blonde boy named Maverick Trevillian, also called the 67 kid, shouting Six-Seven while shrugging at a basketball game. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0022 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
The idle animation of 67 in Steal a Brainrot references the shrugging gesture from the 67 meme video. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0023 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
67 and 25 are the two Brainrots with the shortest names in Steal a Brainrot in terms of characters. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0025 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
67 in Steal a Brainrot has a 1 in 67 chance of being obtained from the Admin Lucky Block. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0026 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
When Sammy (SpyderSammy) first spawned 67 in Steal a Brainrot for Caylus, it had no walking animation and T-posed while walking, and the wiki says this has been fixed. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0027 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy gave out a code for 67 in Steal a Brainrot only because 67 was needed for the Bufalino Boomberino crafting recipe. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0028 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki spells it Boombeirno.]
A code for 67 in Steal a Brainrot made it the first time 67 was seen walking on the Red Carpet, since 67 is otherwise only in the Admin Lucky Block. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0029 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
67 was required for the Los Primos craft in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0030 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
67 in Steal a Brainrot can also be obtained as a rare Brainrot from the Sammy's Base Event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0031 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
67 in Steal a Brainrot was added during the Extinct Event on September 13, 2025. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0032 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | event=2025-09-13 | checked=2026-11-07]
67 in Steal a Brainrot has blue skin, eyes on each digit, no mouth, and emits particles of each digit. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/67 | id=B1-0033 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Abyssaloco
Abyssaloco in Steal a Brainrot is a purple Acanthinucella punctulata sea snail husk with a single blue-iris eye on its operculum and a pair of purple pincers. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Abyssaloco | id=B1-0034 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy (SpyderSammy) once put 20,000 Abyssaloco in the Cyber Craft Machine in Steal a Brainrot, and spawned 2,500 in the Backrooms Event during Taco Tuesday. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Abyssaloco | id=B1-0035 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-05 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki's total is an estimate.]
The wiki estimates that about 25,000 Abyssaloco exist in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Abyssaloco | id=B1-0036 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-05 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Estimate.]
Abyssaloco in Steal a Brainrot is the second best Brainrot from the Backrooms Event, behind Rubrikiko. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Abyssaloco | id=B1-0037 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Addition
Rainbow and Gold in Steal a Brainrot was added to the game in a similar way to Gold and Diamond. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_and_Gold | id=B7-0042 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Agarrini la Palini
Agarrini la Palini in Steal a Brainrot is a brainrot form of the Spanish phrase agarra la pala, which means grab the shovel. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Agarrini_la_Palini | id=B1-0038 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Agarrini la Palini in Steal a Brainrot produces job application particles because agarra la pala is Argentine slang for get a job. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Agarrini_la_Palini | id=B1-0039 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Agarrini la Palini appears as the Agarrini Shovel gear in Steal a Brainrot during the Grave Digger Event, which can be used to dig from your hotbar. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Agarrini_la_Palini | id=B1-0040 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Agarrini Shovel is the only gear in Steal a Brainrot based on a Brainrot, if the Bat, formerly named Tung Bat after Tung Tung Tung Sahur, is not counted. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Agarrini_la_Palini | id=B1-0041 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Agarrini la Palini is alphabetically the first Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot when Brainrots whose names start with numbers and Lucky Blocks are not counted. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Agarrini_la_Palini | id=B1-0042 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Agarrini la Palini in Steal a Brainrot was overhyped by TikTokers as rare, but the wiki says it is now confirmed to be common, which it calls rareslop. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Agarrini_la_Palini | id=B1-0043 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Alessio
Alessio is the second most common Brainrot to get from the Admin Lucky Block in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0044 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Alessio in Steal a Brainrot was introduced during the Admin Abuse war on August 23, 2025. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0045 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | event=2025-08-23 | checked=2026-11-07]
Alessio in Steal a Brainrot is a soccer ball with legs and a face and no visible arms, with slight pink cheeks, giraffe legs and brown boots, and it produces soccer ball particles. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0046 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Alessio and Pop Pop Sahur are cousins in the lore of Steal a Brainrot, which is why their faces look alike. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0047 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Alessio in Steal a Brainrot is related in the lore to Carloo and Matteo. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0048 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Alessio in Steal a Brainrot is slightly rarer than Carloo, though players dislike it for being so common in the Admin Lucky Block. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0049 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
The infobox lists @pollonavale as the creator of Alessio in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Alessio | id=B1-0050 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Alias
Sammyni Cakini in Steal a Brainrot is usually called Birthday Sammy, Sammyni Fattini Reskin or Anniversary Fat Sammy. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Sammyni_Cakini | id=B7-0134 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Seraphino Gruyero in Steal a Brainrot is more commonly known as Divine Starfish. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Seraphino_Gruyero | id=B7-0202 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-07-17 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Animation
The idle animation of Reindeer Tralala in Steal a Brainrot is pushed back about 0.75 studs farther than that of Zombie Tralala. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Reindeer_Tralala | id=B7-0059 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Scarino Crowino in Steal a Brainrot has an idle animation similar to Boppin Bunny. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Scarino_Crowino | id=B7-0186 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
Seraphino Gruyero in Steal a Brainrot is the only Brainrot with a spinning idle animation. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Seraphino_Gruyero | id=B7-0203 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-07-17 | checked=2026-11-07]
Skibidi Toilet in Steal a Brainrot has a walking animation similar to that of Toiletto Focaccino. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Skibidi_Toilet | id=B7-0248 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The subject is blank in the wiki text; the page is about Skibidi Toilet.]
Spooky and Pumpky in Steal a Brainrot shares its animations with Burguro And Fryuro. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Spooky_and_Pumpky | id=B7-0326 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Announcement
The official Steal a Brainrot Discord announced on December 8, 2025 that Skibidi Toilet would arrive soon. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Skibidi_Toilet | id=B7-0245 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | event=2025-12-08 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Anpali Babel
Anpali Babel in Steal a Brainrot has an evil smile, a large nose, bulky black eyebrows, and orange, lava-colored eyes. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0051 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
Anpali Babel's name in Steal a Brainrot is an Indonesian mispronunciation of the Unbelievable sound in Block Blast, which plays when a whole board is cleared. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0052 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The wiki misspells mispronunciation.]
The game on the phone held by Anpali Babel in Steal a Brainrot is Block Blast, not Tetris, though it can look like Tetris. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0053 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
During the trades revamp update in Steal a Brainrot, searching Belula Beluga in the Index showed Anpali Babel instead, a glitch that has since been fixed. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0054 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
Anpali Babel in Steal a Brainrot can be crafted in the Craft Machine from 1x Mastodontico Telepiedone and 3x Te Te Te Sahur. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0055 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
Anpali Babel in Steal a Brainrot can be crafted at the Brainrot Trader from 1x Aquanaut and 1x Chihuanini Taconini, or from 1x Los Gattitos. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0056 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
The infobox lists @ambasamba4 as the creator of Anpali Babel in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Anpali_Babel | id=B1-0057 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-06 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Antonio
Antonio is the fourth Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot to have an actual human name, after Matteo, Carloo and Alessio. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0058 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Antonio in Steal a Brainrot was released on September 6, 2025, along with the Craft Machine. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0059 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | event=2025-09-06 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Wiki writes the date as 9/6/25.]
Antonio in Steal a Brainrot is crafted in the Craft Machine from 2x Ganganzelli Trulala, 1x Bombardiro Crocodilo and 1x Frigo Camelo. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0060 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Ganganzelli Trulala, an ingredient for Antonio in Steal a Brainrot, was a rare Mythic Fuse Machine exclusive, which made Antonio hard to make early on. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0061 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Crafting Antonio in Steal a Brainrot was considered not worth it, since its income compared with its materials came to -$2.9K/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0062 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
The wiki estimates about 1,503 Antonio exist in Steal a Brainrot, with only one Candy mutation, two Bloodrot and three Lava. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0063 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Count is a wiki estimate.]
Antonio in Steal a Brainrot was the worst Brainrot God before being buffed to a Secret making $55M/s, and was later buffed again to $125M/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0064 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Antonio is one of five Brainrots buffed in Update 40 in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0065 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Existing line says four Craft Machine Brainrots were buffed in Update 40; see open notes.]
Before the nerf, Antonio in Steal a Brainrot shared the same stats as Pancake and Syrup and La Secret Combinasion. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0066 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Before its second buff, Antonio in Steal a Brainrot shared stats with Caylusaurus, Steakini Fattini, Hopilikalika Hopilikalako, La Easter Grande and Polaroidini. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0067 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Antonio in Steal a Brainrot wears a dark green tie, a brown belt, dark green pants, a green suit and glasses, with a neutral expression. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0068 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
The infobox lists @alvarito 318 as the creator of Antonio in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Antonio | id=B1-0069 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]

The infobox lists marble.race73 as the creator of Brri Brri Bicus Dicus Bombicus in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Brri_Brri_Bicus_Dicus_Bombicus | id=B1-0283 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-08-02 | checked=2026-11-07]

Buho de Fuego in Steal a Brainrot could be made in the Witch Fuse, and also in the Haunted Fuse. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_de_Fuego | id=B1-0307 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-11 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Buho del Cielo
Buho del Cielo in Steal a Brainrot is very similar to Meowl in design and stance. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_del_Cielo | id=B1-0318 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-08-22 | checked=2026-11-07]

The two tufts on top of Buho del Cielo in Steal a Brainrot are called plumicorns, which are tufts of feathers and not horns. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_del_Cielo | id=B1-0320 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-08-22 | checked=2026-11-07]
Buho del Cielo is a reskin of Buho de Fuego in Steal a Brainrot, and it belongs to the same family as Buho de Noelo and Buho de Volto. Buho del Cielo in Steal a Brainrot stands on a small white cloud and has two orange feet. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_del_Cielo | id=B1-0322 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-08-22 | checked=2026-11-07]
Buho del Cielo in Steal a Brainrot has big yellow-orange irises with no visible sclera. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_del_Cielo | id=B1-0323 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-08-22 | checked=2026-11-07]

Buho de Noelo is the Christmas version of Buho de Fuego in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_de_Noelo | id=B1-0308 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]

[source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_de_Noelo | id=B1-0310 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
Buho de Noelo in Steal a Brainrot has a Christmas wreath for a torso, and a red bow and a bright star on top of its head. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_de_Noelo | id=B1-0311 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
### Buho de Volto

[source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Buho_de_Volto | id=B1-0317 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]

### Cocofanto Elefanto
Cocofanto Elefanto is the cheapest and most common Brainrot God in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0261 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cocofanto Elefanto's income in Steal a Brainrot was raised from $10K/s to $17.5K/s and then to $19K/s, and its cost rose from $5M to $6.5M. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0262 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cocofanto Elefanto was buffed twice in Steal a Brainrot because some Brainrots' incomes exceeded or came close to its income. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0263 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cocofanto Elefanto produces effects similar to Burbaloni Loliloli in Steal a Brainrot, since both are coconut-based. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0264 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy once spawned Cocofanto Elefanto with the Strawberry trait in Steal a Brainrot, which made it look like the Strawberry Elephant. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0265 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
When Steal a Brainrot was released in May 2025, Cocofanto Elefanto was among the best Brainrots, beaten only by Tralalero Tralala. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0266 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
After Cocofanto Elefanto's first buff in Steal a Brainrot, no Brainrot makes $10K/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0267 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cocofanto Elefanto used to have the same stats as Tralalero Tralala in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0268 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cocofanto Elefanto in Steal a Brainrot has a coconut water aura and two large gray ears. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto | id=B2-0269 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-02 | checked=2026-11-07]

### Cola Cat
Cola Cat was originally supposed to be obtained through DLC plushies in Steal a Brainrot, but it was left in the game files with no way to get it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0284 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cola Cat has the longest gap between its leak and official release in Steal a Brainrot, beating Los Sekolahs. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0285 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Diamond mutation of Cola Cat is the second rarest mutated Cola Cat in Steal a Brainrot, just behind the Lava mutation, which has 7 existing. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0286 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Exist count undated on the page.]
Cola Cat in Steal a Brainrot was buffed because of its low exist count. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0287 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
The rarest Cola Cat in Steal a Brainrot is a Strawberry and Bloodrot one, which was also trait farmed. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0288 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
After its buff, Cola Cat in Steal a Brainrot makes the same income as Capitano Moby. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0289 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cola Cat is in the Cyber and Divine indexes in Steal a Brainrot, even though it came out during Crystal. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0290 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Eclipse mutation of Cola Cat in Steal a Brainrot had 0 exists according to the wiki. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0291 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Undated exist count; could change.]
When Cola Cat first appeared in Steal a Brainrot's game files, it made 275K/s. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0292 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cola Cat in Steal a Brainrot is crafted in the Craft Machine from Centrucci Nuclucci, Lazy Ducky, and Sundrilla Sundae. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0293 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cola Cat's torso in Steal a Brainrot is a transparent plastic cup filled with a brown drink and blue ice cubes. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cola_Cat | id=B2-0294 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-05 | checked=2026-11-07]

### Cuadramat and Pakrahmatmamat
Cuadramat and Pakrahmatmamat in Steal a Brainrot was added on November 22, 2025, at 3:00 PM EST, during an Admin Abuse by Sammy (SpyderSammy). [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cuadramat_and_Pakrahmatmamat | id=B2-0313 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | event=2025-11-22 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cuadramat and Pakrahmatmamat is the second Duo Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot to include a Brainrot not yet added, after Los Planitos. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cuadramat_and_Pakrahmatmamat | id=B2-0314 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cuadramat and Pakrahmatmamat is the cheapest Duo Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot at $400M, while other Duos cost $1B or more. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cuadramat_and_Pakrahmatmamat | id=B2-0315 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
The name Cuadramat in Steal a Brainrot comes from the Spanish word Cuaderno, meaning notebook. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cuadramat_and_Pakrahmatmamat | id=B2-0316 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
The name Pakrahmatmamat in Steal a Brainrot comes from Pak Rahmat, a common Indonesian name for a teacher. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cuadramat_and_Pakrahmatmamat | id=B2-0317 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Cuadramat and Pakrahmatmamat was originally named Pencook and Book in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Cuadramat_and_Pakrahmatmamat | id=B2-0318 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]

### Griffin
Griffin in Steal a Brainrot is the oldest Brainrot, made around 2000 BCE, ahead of Cerberus, which was made around 700 BCE. Griffin in Steal a Brainrot has yellow front talons and a sharp orange-ish beak on its bald eagle head, and sharp black claws with a yellow torso on its lion body. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Griffin | id=B4-0005 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-21 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Count is as of the page's September 2026 edit.]

[source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Griffin | id=B4-0006 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-21 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The trait name is blank in the wikitext.]

### Guest 666
Guest 666 in Steal a Brainrot was formerly priced at $1.1B before its cost was raised to $15.6B. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Guest_666 | id=B4-0025 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-04 | checked=2026-11-07]

The 666 in the name of Guest 666 and its $66.6M/s income in Steal a Brainrot is a reference to the Number of the Beast. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Guest_666 | id=B4-0030 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-04 | checked=2026-11-07]
Guest 666 in Steal a Brainrot is the first character with a reference to hell, and Cerberus is the second. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Guest_666 | id=B4-0031 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-04 | checked=2026-11-07]
Guest 666 in Steal a Brainrot has horns in its model, which is different from its source material. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Guest_666 | id=B4-0032 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-04 | checked=2026-11-07]
The actual Guest 666 Roblox avatar had no sword or glowing eyes, unlike the Guest 666 Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Guest_666 | id=B4-0033 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-10-04 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Guest 666 myth was featured in a popular YouTube animated series made by 0bliviousHD, as the wiki describes it for Steal a Brainrot's Guest 666. The baby Hopilikalika Hopilikalako and baby Tirilikalika Tirilikalako in Kalika Bros in Steal a Brainrot have only 1 toe on each foot, unlike the 2 toes on the original models. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0208 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
In the game files of Steal a Brainrot, the Hopilikalika Hopilikalako visual effect in Kalika Bros is named easterthing. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0209 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Datamine detail from the wiki.]
Kalika Bros in Steal a Brainrot was leaked in an Admin Abuse with 1,043 exist counts. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0210 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Leaker name is blank in the wikitext.]
Kalika Bros in Steal a Brainrot has the same stats as Foxini Lanternini. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0211 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy (SpyderSammy) confirmed that Kalika Bros in Steal a Brainrot will be buffed soon. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0212 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=Stated on the wiki; no buff date given.]
Kalika Bros is the most valuable Bros Brainrot in Steal a Brainrot. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0213 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]
Kalika Bros in Steal a Brainrot are both happy, unlike most Los Brainrots, which usually have different personalities. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Kalika_Bros | id=B4-0214 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-01 | checked=2026-11-07]

Karkerheart Luvkur in Steal a Brainrot is holding a rose and has a red heart present box on top of its seat. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerheart_Luvkur | id=B4-0222 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerheart Luvkur in Steal a Brainrot is a Brainrot God even though Karkerkar Kurkur, which it reskins, is a Secret. ### Karkerkar Kurkur
Karkerkar Kurkur in Steal a Brainrot was released on the 10 Billion Visits Event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0224 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerkar Kurkur in Steal a Brainrot is one of the few Brainrots with a special Red Carpet spawn animation. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0225 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Karkerkar ritual in Steal a Brainrot is a musical chairs minigame, and it is the first Brainrot ritual with its own minigame and no special biome. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0226 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
The Karkerkar ritual in Steal a Brainrot is the first Brainrot ritual to have its own minigame, and the one that does not summon a special biome. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0227 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerkar Kurkur is one of the few Brainrots in Steal a Brainrot with human-shaped eyes, along with Rang Ring Bus and Te Te Te Sahur, and all three are Indonesian Brainrots. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0228 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerkar Kurkur in Steal a Brainrot has eyebrows that are the only thing that moves on it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0229 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
A rainbow Karkerkar Kurkur from the RNG Machine in Steal a Brainrot has a face that is much smaller than it should be, due to a glitch. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0230 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerkar Kurkur in Steal a Brainrot has big eyes with a slightly open mouth and a nose. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0231 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerkar Kurkur in Steal a Brainrot can be obtained from the Backrooms Event. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0232 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karkerkar Kurkur in Steal a Brainrot is credited to @sabrandeedat3 as its creator in the infobox. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karkerkar_Kurkur | id=B4-0233 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-09-30 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The Los Karkeritos ritual is listed as broken in the infobox but the trivia says it is not broken; see open notes.]

Karker Sahur in Steal a Brainrot is crafted in the Craft Machine from 2x Karkerkar Kurkur and 1x Ta Ta Ta Ta Sahur. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karker_Sahur | id=B4-0215 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karker Sahur in Steal a Brainrot uses the same recipe as the post-nerf La Karkerkar Combinasion, with a Ta Ta Ta Sahur added to it. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karker_Sahur | id=B4-0216 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Sammy almost accidentally spawned Karker Sahur in Steal a Brainrot on September 27 to 30, which the wiki says would likely have meant La Karkerkar Combinasion was not nerfed. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karker_Sahur | id=B4-0217 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07 | note=The year is not given in the source. The wiki's view that the nerf would not have happened is speculation.]
A Karker Sahur in the Cursed mutation exists in Steal a Brainrot, and the wiki says how it was obtained is unknown. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karker_Sahur | id=B4-0218 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
Karker Sahur in Steal a Brainrot is a deeper blue recolor of Karkerkar Kurkur, with its seat replaced by a tea kettle with a spout. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karker_Sahur | id=B4-0219 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]
In its idle animation, Karker Sahur in Steal a Brainrot jumps up, turns left, spins and sits back down. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Karker_Sahur | id=B4-0220 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-07 | checked=2026-11-07]

### Krupuk Pagi Pagi
The name Krupuk Pagi Pagi in Steal a Brainrot is roughly translated to Morning Cracker Cracker. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Krupuk_Pagi_Pagi | id=B4-0263 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
The name Krupuk Pagi Pagi in Steal a Brainrot refers to the Indonesian routine of eating a cracker and drinking tea or coffee in the morning before starting the day. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Krupuk_Pagi_Pagi | id=B4-0264 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
Many players think Krupuk Pagi Pagi in Steal a Brainrot is a pancake, because they do not know that krupuk is an Indonesian dish. [source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Krupuk_Pagi_Pagi | id=B4-0265 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]

[source: https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Krupuk_Pagi_Pagi | id=B4-0266 | type=community | status=unverified | confidence=medium | pub=2026-11-03 | checked=2026-11-07]
